title: Privileged access reviews completed late
draft_observation: Four of 18 privileged-user access reviews were completed after the fictional 31 March 2026 deadline.
evidence: Fictional tracker shows 18 accounts sampled and 4 late reviews. Access Review Standard v3.1 states reviews are due by month-end.

title: Privileged access reviews delayed
draft_observation: Several privileged access reviews were not completed on time, creating a security risk.
evidence: Fictional tracker shows 4 of 18 reviews were late.
unsupported_claims: The phrase 'creating a security risk' needs specific support.

title: Maker-checker override
draft_observation: A payment was released without the required second approval.
evidence: Fictional payment record PX-1042 shows one approval; fictional Payment Control Standard requires two approvals.

title: Payment approvals not timely
draft_observation: Payment approvals were sometimes delayed and this may expose the bank to losses.
evidence: Fictional dashboard shows 7 of 120 payments exceeded the internal four-hour target.
unsupported_claims: Potential losses are not demonstrated by the supplied evidence.

title: Incomplete income documents
draft_observation: Three of 25 fictional loan files did not contain the required income-verification document.
evidence: Fictional sampling sheet lists files L-011, L-017, and L-023 as missing the document.

title: Loan files not properly maintained
draft_observation: Loan documentation quality is poor because staff do not follow procedures.
evidence: Fictional checklist shows 5 of 30 files with at least one missing document.
unsupported_claims: 'Staff do not follow procedures' is not supported as a cause.

title: Unresolved reconciliation breaks
draft_observation: Two fictional suspense-account breaks remained unresolved for more than 30 days.
evidence: Fictional reconciliation log shows breaks S-201 and S-204 open for 34 and 41 days; Reconciliation Standard allows 30 days.

title: Reconciliation monitoring
draft_observation: Reconciliation breaks are not monitored effectively.
evidence: Fictional log contains 6 breaks, but no ageing or closure information was supplied.
unsupported_claims: 'Not monitored effectively' is a conclusion not supported by the supplied evidence.

title: Missing customer-profile refresh
draft_observation: Five of 40 fictional customer profiles had no recorded annual refresh date.
evidence: Fictional KYC tracker lists five profiles without a refresh date; KYC Procedure v2.0 requires annual refreshes.

title: KYC records incomplete
draft_observation: KYC records are incomplete and could lead to regulatory penalties.
evidence: Fictional review found 5 of 40 profiles without a recorded annual refresh date.
unsupported_claims: Regulatory penalties are not established by the supplied evidence.

title: Dormant vendor accounts
draft_observation: Two fictional vendor accounts remained active after 90 days without transactions.
evidence: Fictional vendor report shows accounts V-008 and V-014 had no transactions for 96 and 121 days; Dormant Vendor Rule requires review after 90 days.

title: Vendor master data issue
draft_observation: There are issues in the vendor master file.
evidence: Fictional report shows 3 duplicate-looking vendor names but no confirmed duplicate records.
unsupported_claims: The finding implies confirmed issues although the evidence shows only possible duplicates.

title: Leaver access removal
draft_observation: One fictional leaver account remained enabled for two business days after the recorded exit date.
evidence: Fictional HR-to-access log shows exit on 10 April and disablement on 12 April; Access Removal Procedure requires one business day.

title: Access removal weakness
draft_observation: Leaver access is a major cybersecurity exposure.
evidence: Fictional log shows one account disabled two days after exit; no access-use evidence was supplied.
unsupported_claims: 'Major cybersecurity exposure' is broader than the supplied evidence.

title: Manual payment exception
draft_observation: One fictional manual payment had no documented exception reason.
evidence: Fictional payment record MP-221 shows manual processing and blank exception-reason field.

title: Collateral valuation evidence
draft_observation: Two fictional loan files lacked a current collateral valuation date.
evidence: Fictional sample of 20 files identifies L-004 and L-019; Credit File Standard requires valuation refresh every 12 months.

title: Old suspense items
draft_observation: Old suspense items indicate a breakdown in financial reporting.
evidence: Fictional suspense report shows 3 items open for 35, 38, and 45 days; no reporting misstatement was demonstrated.
unsupported_claims: A reporting breakdown is not established by the supplied evidence.

title: Unreviewed high-risk profiles
draft_observation: High-risk fictional profiles were not reviewed and may involve money laundering.
evidence: Fictional review sheet shows 2 profiles without a quarterly review marker; no suspicious-activity evidence was supplied.

title: Vendor review recommendation
draft_observation: The vendor review process should be improved.
evidence: Fictional review shows 4 of 16 vendors lacked a documented annual review date.
unsupported_claims: None stated, but the recommendation is too vague.

title: Complete payment exception finding
draft_observation: Three of 50 fictional payments exceeded the approval threshold and were approved by an officer without documented delegated authority.
evidence: Fictional sample identifies PX-110, PX-118, and PX-131; Payment Delegation Matrix v1.4 requires delegated authority evidence.
